_comment: The game's FIRST HARD STUN (plan-cc-and-retaliation.md C3, PO rulings D6/D7/D8 2026-08-08). Holds the nearest eligible mob for 3 s at L1 → 3.8 s at L5: movement stops AND its cast path is suppressed. ⚑ That second half is what makes it a stun rather than a ROOT — movement and aura cadence run on independent paths, so a 100 % slow leaves a mob standing perfectly still and still swinging. Capped at maxTargets 1 / nearest, like CharmBeast: the GDD forbids target-clicking, so 'walk to the one you want' IS the targeting, and an uncapped hard stun would neutralise a whole pack off one button. ⚑ Damage does NOT break it (D8): in an aura game your own damage is always on, so break-on-damage would end the stun on the tick it landed. ⚑ It authors NO targetFactions allowlist, unlike Calm and CharmBeast — those need one because 'which mobs can be calmed/charmed' is a content question; for a stun the mob-side factors.ccImmune gate (C1) already answers it, so every elite and boss is immune and everything else is fair game. A stunned mob KEEPS its threat table and its target (A5): calm is the disengage tool, this is the control tool, and a stun that also wiped aggro would be a strictly better calm. Cost sits between Calm (0.015) and CharmBeast (0.05). GiantSpider drop at 0.2 — paralytic venom, and the spider is the fastest thing in the roster, so the counter it teaches is the one you wanted while fighting it. All values [PLACEHOLDER]
name: Paralyze
description: Damage does not break it, your own aura included.
